title: stelis wagneri
intro: Stelis wagneri, commonly known as the "Bee Orchid", is a species of orchid native to Brazil. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions due to its rich store of bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds. The health benefits of Stelis wagneri include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its flavonoids, particularly kaempferol and quercetin, which may help to modulate the nervous system and promote relaxation.
